text.text_excerpt: Top 3 Fried Chicken in the city. Seriously. Really. A gas station. I read rave reviews for the chicken at Lil Dizzy's (adequate at best) and the classic over touristed and ridiculously over rated Willy Mae's (which lost most of the charm it had when Willie Mae stopped hanging around the kitchen) and laugh. Those down home style places can't come close to the fried delights under the heat lamps manned by hispanics that barely speak English at this Middle Eastern owned gas station. It sounds like I'm being sarcastic, probably because I usually am, but these are the facts. The chickens crunch and flavor is rivaled by only Coops and McHardy's in this city but for $14 you're getting 25 pieces ...

This is the place to go for all of your tailgating or party needs! Seriously. If your watching a sports balls game of any sort, come in, grab 50 pieces of chicken and all of your sides for a reasonable price. Yes, they have about a dozen gas pumps in front. Yes it is a gas station and convenience store. I will admit that it has taken me awhile to get over the oddness of getting decent food from a gas station, but you can, and you not only won't die because of gas station food (well, you won't die today, and not specifically because something is wrong with the food), but you might enjoy it. The convenience store has plenty of options for liquor, beer, snacks, and other sundry items. Any of...

Quickie express mart for all your needs! I do mean all your needs. This is literally a Wally Mart in the form of a gas station/Popeye's Chicken. Anti Freeze Chips Soft drinks Liquor/Beer Smokes ATM Fuel Tacos $5 PoBoys And.....drum roll please..... 24 Hour Fried Chicken! ~Christy
